how_obtained.WHY THAT RE-VERIFICATION MATTERS: the session scratchpad is SHARED with the sibling curation agents in this run. A glob copy out of it put 17 figure files from OTHER papers into source/figs/. They were found by listing the directory immediately after the copy and deleted; the six survivors were then re-hashed against pmc_fetch's own report, 6/6 identical. A file-count or size check would have passed. Recorded in 08_contradictions.csv.
